visualCharacteristics: Two equal columns, text beside an illustration or product image, vertically centred; stacks on mobile with the image first
contentPattern: One row, two columns: a text column (paragraphs, list, CTA links or linked store badge images) and an image column, in either order.
usage: Promotional text next to an illustration or app screenshots, e.g. Business Profile login or app download sections.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single text + image pairing. Author the columns in the order they should appear on desktop.
